queries_attempted: predict customer churn with usage data software
SaaS health score calculator NPS tickets
best customer success software health scores

competitors.name: Gainsight CS
competitors.notes: Purpose-built customer success platform. Automatically calculates health scores from usage, tickets, surveys, and other sources. Industry leader.
competitors.feature_overlap: Full overlap: automated health scoring from multiple data sources, playbooks, dashboards.
competitors.market_positioning: The leader in customer success, targets mid-to-large B2B SaaS.

competitors.name: Totango
competitors.notes: Enterprise customer success platform with configurable health scores pulling from usage, support, and surveys.
competitors.feature_overlap: Comprehensive: health profiles, success plays, integrations.
competitors.market_positioning: Enterprise customer success for recurring revenue businesses.

competitors.name: ChurnZero
competitors.notes: Real-time customer success platform with automated health scores, alerts, and plays. Integrates with CRMs and product analytics.
competitors.feature_overlap: Full: health scores from usage, tickets, NPS; churn prediction.
competitors.market_positioning: Real-time customer success intelligence, strong churn focus.

competitors.name: ClientSuccess
competitors.notes: Customer success platform with health score builder, customer 360, and engagement tracking.
competitors.feature_overlap: Yes, health score from support tickets, product usage, NPS.
competitors.pricing: From $200/user/month, higher tiers for health scoring
competitors.market_positioning: Purpose-built for mid-market SaaS and tech companies.

competitors.name: Planhat
competitors.notes: Customer success platform with custom health scores, workspaces, and data integration.
competitors.feature_overlap: Direct: health score builder, playbooks, integrations.
competitors.pricing: Starts at $1,000/month for up to 500 customers
competitors.market_positioning: Modern, customizable CS platform for growing SaaS businesses.

competitors.name: Catalyst
competitors.notes: Customer success intelligence platform with centralized customer data and health scoring.
competitors.market_positioning: Centralized customer data with actionable insights.

competitors.name: Custify
competitors.notes: Customer success platform focused on SaaS; automated health scores, lifecycle management.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated health scoring from multiple sources.
competitors.market_positioning: Affordable CS platform for small-to-mid sized SaaS.

competitors.name: Vitally
competitors.notes: Customer success platform with real-time health scores, alerts, and analytics.
competitors.feature_overlap: Full overlap: health scoring, notifications, integrations.
competitors.market_positioning: Elegant CS platform for modern SaaS teams.

competitors.name: Hook
competitors.notes: Customer success platform with automated health scoring, alerts, and workflow automation.
competitors.feature_overlap: Health scores from usage, support, and custom data.
competitors.market_positioning: Lightweight, automated CS for early-stage startups.

competitors.name: Pendo
competitors.notes: Product analytics and guidance, can compute health scores from product usage and integrate with other signals, but not a dedicated CS platform.
competitors.feature_overlap: Usage-based health scoring capabilities; lacks advanced ticket/NPS integration without additional tools.
competitors.pricing: Starts at free for 500 MAU, paid plans $1,000+/month
competitors.market_positioning: Product experience and analytics, with CS module (Pendo Engage).

competitors.name: HubSpot Service Hub
competitors.notes: Customer service suite with health score property (based on ticket volume, feedback) but limited automated integration with non-HubSpot usage data.
competitors.feature_overlap: Basic health score functionality, surveys (NPS), tickets; less on product usage analytics.

competitors.name: Salesforce Service Cloud
competitors.notes: Can build health scores using custom fields and flows, but requires setup; integrates with third-party usage apps.
competitors.feature_overlap: Possible to configure health scores; not out-of-the-box automated from multiple sources without custom development.

competitors.name: Mixpanel
competitors.notes: Product analytics that can segment users by health indicators (usage frequency, feature adoption) and trigger alerts, but lacks natively integrated ticket and NPS scoring.
competitors.feature_overlap: Can be used as part of health score with manual export/import.

competitors.name: Google Sheets + Zapier
competitors.notes: Many CSMs build custom health dashboards by pulling data from various tools into a spreadsheet, combining manually. Not a product but a common workaround.
competitors.feature_overlap: Mimics health scores at very low cost, high manual effort.

competitors.name: Amplitude
competitors.notes: Product analytics platform that offers user scoring and predictive analysis, but lacks native integration with support tickets and NPS; requires manual data feeds.
competitors.feature_overlap: Usage health scoring; not a full CS platform.
competitors.market_positioning: Digital analytics for product and growth teams.

competitors.name: Zendesk + Custom Integration
competitors.notes: Support ticketing with NPS surveys, but no product usage data native. Health scoring requires custom development using API and external tools.
competitors.feature_overlap: Partial: ticket volume and satisfaction can be used for health if combined manually.

substitutes.name: Homegrown spreadsheet health dashboard
substitutes.notes: CSMs export data from analytics, support, and CRM into Excel, then manually calculate a health score using formulas.

substitutes.name: CRM custom fields and reports
substitutes.notes: Using Salesforce or HubSpot custom properties to create basic health metrics, but often lacks automation and holistic view.

summary: The customer health scoring market is crowded with mature, purpose-built solutions (Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat, etc.) that directly address the JTBD. These tools integrate usage, tickets, and NPS to generate automated health scores, often with playbooks and workflows. Many also offer predictive churn capabilities. Additionally, partial competitors like product analytics platforms (Pendo, Amplitude) and CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce) have some health scoring features, while low-end substitutes (sheets, Zendesk mashups) exist. The market has been well-defined for years, and barriers to entry include deep integrations and mature feature sets. A new entrant would face significant headwinds without a unique differentiator. The competitive landscape scores 4 (crowded market) due to the number of direct and partial competitors.
